newsitem.title: USA: Hilton files ITT tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Hilton files ITT tender offer.

text.p: Hilton Hotels Corp., which has launched a $6.5 billion bid for rival hotel and casino operator ITT Corp., Friday filed its formal tender offer with government regulators.

Hilton's proposed acquisition, for $55 a share, would create a hotel and casino giant with 30 casinos and roughly $2.5 billion in annual cash flow, making it three to five times the size of its nearest rival.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the hotel and gambling giant said the offer to buy 61 million shares of common stock is not conditioned on obtaining financing.
The offer will expire at midnight Feb. 28 unless it is extended, it said.
Hilton Hotels estimated that it will need about $3.5 billion to buy the outstanding ITT Corp. shares and to pay fees and expenses related to the planned takeover.
Hilton expects to obtain the funds required to complete the deal from available cash, working capital, existing credit facilities and new borrowings, according to the filing.
The offer also includes the assumption of $4 billion in debt.
ITT's stock gained 25 cents to $57.125 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange. Hilton slipped 12.5 cents to $28.50, also on the NYSE.
